en.title: Chinese student at Moscow State University stirs controversy by draping Rising Sun flag in class; school opens probe
en.summary: The Association of Chinese Students and Scholars at Moscow State University said a Chinese exchange student draped himself in the Rising Sun flag during class and that the university has begun an investigation.

ja.title: モスクワ大の中国人留学生、授業中に旭日旗をまとい物議　大学が調査開始

zh.title: 莫斯科大学一中国留学生课堂上披旭日旗引发争议　校方展开调查
